Program Overview

What You'll Experience

Tours & Immersion

Go inside airport operations, General Aviation, Southwest Airlines, TPA Maintenance, the Airport Operations Center, and Prospect Services — real work, real access.

Daily Leadership Messages

Each morning opens with a TPA leader sharing how their career started — including live success stories from Johan and Yasmin who went from volunteer to TPA staff.

Career Skills Training

Résumé writing, interview and presentation skills, communication, personal branding, financial literacy for your first paycheck — delivered by TPA HR and our program partners.

Volunteer Ambassador Pathway

TPA's Volunteer Ambassador Program (100 hours earns parking + builds your résumé) is a direct on-ramp to employment even after the week ends.
